en: Data query actions have no submit step: the system completes them when the query is satisfied; the follower can only "Check now".
zh-CN: 数据查询动作没有提交入口：查到满足即由系统完成；执行人是跟进人，只能「立即检查」。

en: Outputs are written to {actionKey}.{outputName} and can be used in later edge conditions.
zh-CN: 输出写入 {actionKey}.{outputName}，可在后续连线条件中引用。

en: Can only check now or transfer
{count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · written to process variables

zh-CN: 系统检查：{criteria} · 每 5 分钟重查

en: Actions completed by the system have no submitter. "Check now" goes to the operation audit only, not to this activity log; failed checks are only logged and alerted.
zh-CN: 系统完成的动作由系统记录，提交人为空；「立即检查」只记入操作审计，不进入活动记录。检查失败只记日志与告警。

en: The criteria text key must start with a lowercase letter and use letters, digits, ".", "_" or "-" (up to 128).
zh-CN: 完成标准文案键须以小写字母开头，只含字母、数字、“.”、“_”或“-”，最长 128 位。

en: Enum output "{name}" needs at least one allowed value, without duplicates.
zh-CN: 枚举输出“{name}”至少需要一个可选值，且不能重复。

en: Output name "{name}" is used more than once (case-insensitive).
zh-CN: 输出名“{name}”重复（不区分大小写）。

en: Output name "{name}" must start with a letter and contain only letters, digits and underscores.
zh-CN: 输出名“{name}”须以字母开头，只含字母、数字与下划线。

en: The query template code must be uppercase letters, digits and underscores (2–64), starting with a letter.
zh-CN: 查询模板编码须为大写字母、数字与下划线（2—64 位），以字母开头。

en: Completes automatically when the check passes; rechecked every 5 minutes.
zh-CN: 检查通过后自动完成，每 5 分钟重查一次。

en: The node stays open and the system keeps rechecking; no alert is sent for this.
zh-CN: 节点保持未完成，系统会继续重查，不会因此报错或通知。

en: {count, plural, one {# failure} other {# failures}} in a row
{count, plural, one {# system check} other {# system checks}}, completed automatically once satisfied
zh-CN: {count} 个系统检查，满足后由系统自动完成

en: A check is already running. Refresh in a moment.
zh-CN: 已有检查在进行，请稍后刷新。

en: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} not yet satisfied
Checked: {count, plural, one {# item is} other {# items are}} still not satisfied.
zh-CN: 已检查：仍有 {count} 项未满足。

en: {open, plural, one {# check is} other {# checks are}} still not satisfied. Once all are, the system moves on automatically; you don't need to submit anything.
zh-CN: 还有 {open} 项检查未满足；全部满足后系统自动推进，无需你提交。

en: The follower can click "Check now" at any time
zh-CN: 跟进人可随时点「立即检查」

en: Only the first row is read. Several rows, a missing declared column or a wrong type count as a failed check, and the node stays open.
zh-CN: 系统只读第一行。多行、缺少声明的列或类型不符，都按「检查失败」处理，节点保持未完成。

en: The assignee is a follower: there is no Complete button; the system completes it once satisfied
zh-CN: 执行人是跟进人：没有完成按钮，满足后由系统完成

en: Reason codes when not satisfied, comma-separated, e.g. CASE_NOT_APPROVED.
zh-CN: 未满足的原因码，逗号分隔，例如 CASE_NOT_APPROVED。

en: Checked once as soon as the node starts
zh-CN: 节点开始时立即检查一次

en: Once satisfied it isn't reopened if the data later changes; each business system still controls its own transactions.
zh-CN: 满足后不会因为数据回退而重新打开。能否交易仍由各业务系统自己控制，流程只负责引导。

en: Converted to the declared type and written to the process variable.
zh-CN: 按上表声明的类型转换后写入流程变量。
之后每 5 分钟自动重查

zh-CN: 1 / 0 或 true / false。为真即完成该动作。
